name: jelph-ov-planner
description: Jelph OV Planner — smarter multimodal route planning for the Netherlands

scripts.build: npm run build -w @jelph/planner && npm run build -w @jelph/api && npm run build -w @jelph/web && npm run build -w @jelph/cli && npm run build -w @jelph/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jelph/planner && npm run typecheck -w @jelph/api && npm run typecheck -w @jelph/cli && npm run typecheck -w @jelph/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @jelph/web
